why_this_part: NC-056 (L55): candidate driver-sized replacement for the MJE15032 in the Class A emitter follower of the gain block (circuits/preamp/gain_block.py:717-718). The MJE15032 model has CJE = 3.06 nF; this model has CJE = 220 pF, and at the follower's 20 mA the model's Cpi is 1.70 nF against 8.09 nF. Chosen after the vetting recorded in docs/preamp/data/2026-10-29/L55/modelli/README.md: it is the only candidate that passed T7 (manufacturer-served model), T8 (Active on the manufacturer's page), real franchised stock for BOTH polarities, a model that is physical at 20 mA, and a thermal path with a stocked heat sink. The other candidates fail at least one of these (README table).

how_the_model_url_was_found: The pattern of limitations #18 / L24: /download/models/lib/<lowercase part>.lib. Checked as the limitation asks - Content-Type application/octet-stream and 994 bytes (the soft-404 is 303722 bytes of text/html) - and then the file was opened and its header read (limitations #20): '.MODEL Qmje243 npn', the right part and polarity. The file declares no package.
revision_note: Read from the document footer: 'December, 2024 - Rev. 17', publication order number MJE243/D (copyright line 2014). PDF CreationDate 16 Dec 2024. Model: 'Model generated on Jan 22, 03', PSpice format, MODPEX / Symmetry Design Systems (the same contractor as the MJE15032 model).

limits_read_with_their_conditions.reading_method: pdftotext for the layout, then the RENDERED page 2 and 4 (pdftocairo -r 110) looked at for every row, because limitations #19 says onsemi PDFs lose the micro prefix. The rendered rows agree with the extraction on every value quoted below.
limits_read_with_their_conditions.V_CEO: 100 V MINIMUM (V_CEO(sus), IC = 10 mA, IB = 0). Maximum ratings: VCEO 100 V, VCB 100 V, VEB (= V_EBO) 7.0 V, IC 4.0 A continuous / 8.0 A peak, IB 1.0 A. Against +/-15 V rails (30 V) 3.3x; against +/-20 V (40 V, regulator short) 2.5x.
limits_read_with_their_conditions.V_EBO: 7.0 V (Maximum ratings 'Emitter-Base Voltage VEB 7.0 Vdc'; I_EBO max 0.1 uA at 7.0 V). With a 1N4148 in antiparallel on the base-emitter (ADR-095) the reverse base-emitter voltage is held near 0.7 V, 10x inside.
limits_read_with_their_conditions.hFE: 40 min / 180 max at IC = 200 mA, VCE = 1.0 V; 15 min at IC = 1.0 A. NOTHING is specified at the follower's 20 mA: the design point is 10x below the lowest specified current (as for the MJE15032, which was 34x below). Fig. 8 shows the typical curve down to 40 mA.
limits_read_with_their_conditions.fT: 40 MHz MIN at IC = 100 mA, VCE = 10 V, ftest = 10 MHz (fT = |hfe| x ftest). Not specified at 20 mA.
limits_read_with_their_conditions.C_ob: 50 pF MAX at VCB = 10 V, IE = 0, f = 0.1 MHz. Fig. 7 gives the typical curve: NPN ~30 pF at 10 V (~20 pF at 30 V), PNP ~17 pF at 10 V.
limits_read_with_their_conditions.P_D: 15 W at TC = 25 C (derate 120 mW/C); 1.5 W at TA = 25 C (derate 12 mW/C).
limits_read_with_their_conditions.thermal: R_thJC 8.34 C/W MAX; R_thJA 83.4 C/W MAX (free air, no heat sink); TJ max +150 C (operating range -65 to +150).
limits_read_with_their_conditions.package: TO-225 (CASE 77-09, Issue AD, 25 Mar 2015). Pin 1 emitter, pin 2 and the tab (pin 4) collector, pin 3 base: THE TAB IS THE COLLECTOR and is not isolated. Body D 10.6-11.1 mm, E 7.4-7.8 mm, A 2.4-3.0 mm, mounting hole P 2.9-3.3 mm, Q 3.8-4.2 mm.

spice_model.ngspice_note: ngspice 47 cannot find the op of a deck with this model, base grounded, collector at 10 V and the emitter on 1 TOhm (all gmin and source stepping fail, a transient op is used and gives a wrong point). With 1 GOhm it converges. The validation recipe uses 1 GOhm; see tb_mje243() in scripts/validate_models.py.
